submission.justification: Mixture-G1 with a 2mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.904 ns across all tested configurations. This represents a significant performance improvement of 30.7% over Mixture-G3 (1.305 ns) and 52.8% over Mixture-G2 (1.914 ns). The 2mm gap is optimal for this mixture, providing better resolution than both the 1mm gap (1.016 ns) and 3mm gap (1.055 ns). This configuration falls well within the allowed gap range of 1-3mm and meets all design constraints while delivering superior time resolution performance critical for the muon chamber upgrade.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G1 at 2mm gap delivers 0.904 ns time resolution, which is the best among all 9 tested configurations (3 mixtures × 3 gaps)
